items.title: Joel Dorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: I got a new girl I just signed to Rykodisc, it’s like a twenty- first century Carole King

ctx.x: Anybody that I brought in or anybody that I bring in now, you know, once we get that first layer, whether it’s voice and piano, voice and rhythm, saxophone, whatever it is — the basic layer where the record’s complete, now if you add stuff it’ll work or not work based on whether if it works or not works. The only time I use arrangers would be for specific things, like strings, sometimes horns. But voices, even with horns sometimes I’ll get like three or four guys and we’ll just say like all right, what goes here?…
You must have a certain reputation in the business. © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-
